description: Intent i012 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=chardev-ioctl-divisor) complete. Finding: drivers/media/dvb-frontends/stv0367.c, stv0367cab_algo(), lines 2316-2370. Untrusted source: p->symbol_rate (u32, struct dtv_frontend_properties) set by unprivileged users through the DVB chardev ioctl path (DTV property set / FE_SET_FRONTEND; dvb_frontend.c line 1187 copies u.qam.symbol_rate, line ~1929 c->symbol_rate = data). Violated invariant: dvb_frontend_check_parameters() (dvb_frontend.c:970-1001) range-checks only the RAW symbol_rate and only for selected delivery systems; the derived divisors are never proven nonzero at division width. Unsafe use: line 2322 'TRLTimeOut = 100000000 / p->symbol_rate;' (zero symbol_rate => divide-by-zero) and line 2365 'CRLTimeOut = (25 * CRLSymbols * (cab_state->search_range / 1000)) / (p->symbol_rate / 1000);' where the right-shift-equivalent truncation symbol_rate/1000 yields 0 for user values 1..999, plus line 2368 '(1000 * CRLTimeOut) / p->symbol_rate'. This mirrors the seed (checks validate f's input, division executes on f's output: 8*speed wrapping to 0). Impact: kernel divide-by-zero oops in the frontend tune path (DoS/reliability). Confidence medium because the driver registers symbol_rate_min=870000/max=11700000 (stv0367.c:2840-2841), which the core check would enforce for cable delivery systems; the residual doubt is the delivery-system-dependent default branch that skips the range check and paths reaching stv0367cab_set_frontend (lines 2518-2566, which performs no symbol_rate validation of its own). Safe candidates verified with exact evidence: ds3000.c:953-975 (raw symbol_rate range-checked >= 1000000 before symbol_rate/1000 division), dvb_frontend.c:1842 (divides by constants 16000/2000, symbol_rate is numerator), cx24113.c:473 and zl10036.c:315 (divide by constants; scaled value is numerator). Negative/bounded evidence: IIO chardev ioctls (industrialio-core.c, industrialio-buffer.c) expose no numeric divisor parameters; the seed mechanism itself is still present in vega10_thermal.c:302-320 but belongs to other intents' branches. Limitations: reachability of the zero divisor verified by source reading only (no compile/reproducer); sweep of every media/misc ioctl divisor expression beyond symbol_rate-family denominators was not exhaustive.
